stylePrompt: Premium editorial SaaS visual aligned to the two UI reference screenshots: clean modern composition, generous negative space, soft pale-blue/lilac fields, restrained peach warmth, deep blue-black subjects, and cobalt accents. Subtle grain is allowed. Use broad low-contrast gradients and fine curved-line motifs sparingly; no neon, chrome, glass overload, or generic purple AI glow. Images must feel calm, trustworthy, human, and suitable for legal/certified translation. No text unless explicitly requested. Use diverse, dignified, non-stereotypical people. Do not imitate or reproduce any person, brand, logo, or proprietary image from the references.
